name: Kiryuu Yamato
source:
A sophomore in high school who loves to play hero. He is a Shiba Inu half-breed, but he hates being treated like a dog.

He is friendly and has many friends now, but in junior high school, he used to get into fights all the time.
translation:
A sophomore in high school who loves to play hero. He is a Shiba Inu half-breed, but he hates being treated like a dog.

He is friendly and has many friends now, but in junior high school, he used to get into fights all the time.
